<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC(=O)c2nnn(Cc3ccc(CN4CC(F)C4)cc3)c2N)c1",
    "bonds_broken": ["C-Cl"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-N"],
    "limit": 10
}</action_input>

Let's output that.
